analyst_summary: Synthetic fixed facts only; they do not establish live demand or market performance. Shop has very low stock against repeated sales and stockouts, supporting a bounded stock-coverage response if fresh-supply guards are met. Buyer conversion is 6%, but no buyer execution breakdown or mature challenger evidence supports changing buyer settings or promoting a trial. The price-frontier issue and 9 versus 20 required mature paid samples favor waiting on economic promotion.
critic_summary: Synthetic fixtures only; these do not establish live demand or market performance. Low reported stock alongside repeat sales and stockouts supports considering bounded stock coverage, subject to fresh-supply guards and the full refund reserve. The buyer data does not identify a specific conversion bottleneck. The price-frontier issue and 9 of 20 required mature paid samples do not support economic promotion.
